definitions.explanation: An occasion when people come together. An assembly or get-together.
A set of things or people gathered in one place.

examples.japanese: {集|あつ}まり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集|あつ}まり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}しました→参加：02498_sanka⟧。
examples.english: I participated in a friends' gathering.
It's a group of good people.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{色々|いろいろ}な→色々：02352_iroiro⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集|あつ}まり⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This class is a collection of people from various countries.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}な→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集|あつ}まり⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: That company is said to be a group of talented people.

notes:
{集|あつ}まり is the noun form of ⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧ (to gather).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集|あつ}まり (a gathering of people)
- {集|あつ}まり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (good/poor turnout)
- {集|あつ}まり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (participate in a gathering)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧: to gather (intransitive verb)
- ⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to collect (transitive verb)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{会合|かいごう}→会合：02605_kaigou⟧: meeting (formal)
- {集|あつ}まり: gathering (casual)
- ⟦{集会|しゅうかい}→集会：14654_shuukai⟧: assembly, rally
